description: This PHP source file defines the SubscriptionsAdminController class within the Goteo framework. The class manages administrative actions related to subscriptions, including listing and filtering subscriptions via the Stripe API. It interacts with models such as Project and external services like Stripe, and generates responses for the admin interface.

classes.name: SubscriptionsAdminController
classes.description: A controller class handling admin-level management of Stripe subscriptions, including listing subscriptions with filters and integrating with project data.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Handles the retrieval and filtering of subscriptions from Stripe, gathers related project and status data, and renders the admin subscriptions list view.
